children: MEXICO CITY, Sept 9 (Reuters) - Mexican consumer prices rose 3.26% in the year through August, the national statistics agency said on Wednesday.     Consumer prices (MXINFL=ECI) rose 0.20% in August, according to non-seasonally adjusted figures.     The core index, which strips out some volatile food and energy prices, rose 0.16% during the month (MXCPIX=ECI).
